name: Adzviser Matomo
description:
Connect your Matomo analytics data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about visits, pageviews, and conversions. Compare traffic sources, dig into page and referrer performance, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Matomo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Matomo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://matomo.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Matomo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Matomo provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_matomo, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Matomo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Matomo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Matomo MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Matomo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Matomo is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
